ZLA Sector 12 (West Flow).description: Sector 12 works arrivals into the Los Angeles area and departures from KSNA, KONT and KRIV. The size of the sector makes it complex due to the lack of space. Traffic conflicts arise within the sector between KSNA and KONT departures climbing eastbound on converging courses and southbound KSNA and KONT departures climbing out with Los Angeles basin arrivals descending over CYNDE.

ZLA Sector 09 (West Flow).description:
Most of Sector 09's traffic is made up of San Diego area arrivals and departures, military traffic transitioning between MCAS Miramar, NAF El Centro, and MCAS Yuma, and the various restricted areas and MOAs/ATCAAs located in the surrounding airspace. In addition, Sector 09 also provides approach control services for KIPL and the other non-towered airports within the sector limits. Much of the complexity in this sector is derived from the different types and speeds of aircraft that enter the airspace and the high volume of Special Use Airspace (SUA) activity. 

The major conflict point in Sector 09 is between San Diego arrivals descending west of IPL and San Diego departures climbing eastbound toward IPL.

ZLA Sector 09/12 Combined (West Flow).description: See individual descriptions for Sectors 09 and 12 for traffic variety and conflict points.

ZLA Sectors 21/22 (West Flow).description:
Sector 21/22 works southbound, eastbound and northeast bound departures from several Los Angeles basin airports, in addition to San Diego and Orange County departures filed towards LAX and the Ventura area. Complexity within the sector comes from the blending of many traffic flows and the varying aircraft types that fly these routes. Additional complexity comes from the interaction of San Diego area arrivals with aircraft climbing out on several of these departure routes. 

Conflict points within the sector include the crossover point between San Diego area arrivals and Los Angeles basin departures and San Diego area departures with both Orange County departures and southbound Los Angeles basin departures.
